title: Adam Driver Teases His ‘X-Men’ Villain Mister Sinister to Seth Meyers
content:
ByMarlow Stern

Chief Correspondent

Robert Pattinsonisn’t the only A-lister who’s appeared in multiple massive movie franchises.

Adam Driverstarred as the lightsaber-wielding antagonist Kylo Ren in the “Star Wars” trilogy and will don a cape once more as Dr. Nathaniel Essex, akaMister Sinister— a hyperintelligent, shape-shifting telepath and the main villain inMarvel’s upcoming “X-Men” rebootdirected by Jake Schreier. And, during his appearance on “Late Night with Seth Meyers” Monday to promote the James Gray film “Paper Tiger,” the Oscar-nominated actor was asked a series of questions by the talk-show host about the upcoming superhero movie.

First, Meyers held up a photo of Mister Sinister — body suit, sharp collar, shredded cape, makeup and all — to which Driver quipped, “[Looks] just like me. This is 6 a.m. when my daughter wakes me up.”

He then asked the “Girls” and “Marriage Story” performer how familiar he was with Mister Sinister prior to joining the cast. “Yes. Not to the degree — I was more aware of Magneto. I was abigX-Menfan… My cousin Tony would come over, and he made these Sabretooth costume things with the yellow rubber gloves and put toothpicks out the side, and I would dress as Wolverine.”

Driver added that his 10-year-old son, who’d previously expressed little to no interest in watching his films, is finally looking forward to one of them. “My son is actually excited about ‘X-Men.’ Plus, at this point, he’s getting older and hasn’t seen anything that I’ve been in, but he’s been to sets. He wants to see me in something,” offered Driver.

MarvelStudios honcho Kevin Feige admitted he’d been courting Driver for quite some time before he finally caved with “X-Men,” though the actor would usually engage in discussions with Marvel before politely declining. “It’s no secret we’d like to [work with Adam],” Feige told the “Happy Sad Confused” podcast. “But it’s a tradition to Zoom with him and then he passes. That’s a long-lived tradition. He couldn’t be more cordial. He is usually upfront about how he is feeling.”

Schreier’s upcoming “X-Men” reboot will see Driver square off against Sadie Sink as Jean Grey,Inde Navarretteas Rogue, Kit Connor as Cyclops, Maya Boyd as Storm, Asa Germann as Angel and Christopher Abbott as Charles Xavier/Professor X. The film will hit theaters May 5, 2028.
title_zh: 亞當·德賴佛(Adam Driver)在《今夜秀》(Late Night)中向塞斯·梅耶斯(Seth Meyers)透露了他在《X戰警》(X-Men)中飾演的反派角色神秘人(Mister Sinister)的消息。
content_zh:
作者：馬洛·斯特恩(Marlow Stern)

首席記者

羅伯特·帕丁森(Robert Pattinson)並不是唯一一位參與多個大型電影系列的A級明星。

亞當·德賴佛(Adam Driver)在《星際大戰》(Star Wars)三部曲中飾演持光劍的反派凱羅·倫(Kylo Ren)，並將再次披上斗篷，飾演納撒尼爾·艾克斯(Dr. Nathaniel Essex)，也就是神秘人(Mister Sinister)——一位超高智商、變形的心靈感應者，也是漫威即將上映的《X戰警》(X-Men)重啟版的主要反派，該片由傑克·施瑞爾(Jake Schreier)執導。在他週一出現在《與塞斯·梅耶斯的深夜秀》(Late Night with Seth Meyers)以宣傳詹姆斯·格雷(James Gray)的電影《紙老虎》(Paper Tiger)時，這位奧斯卡提名演員被主持人問及了一系列關於即將上映的超級英雄電影的問題。

首先，梅耶斯展示了一張神秘人的照片——全身緊身衣、尖銳的領口、撕裂的斗篷、化妝等等，德賴佛打趣道：“[看起來]就像我。這是早上六點，當我女兒叫醒我的時候。”

接著，他詢問這位《女孩們》(Girls)和《婚姻故事》(Marriage Story)的演員，在加入演員陣容之前對神秘人有多熟悉。“是的。但不至於那麼熟悉——我對萬磁王(Magneto)更有印象。我是個大X戰警迷……我表哥托尼(Tony)會來我家，他會用黃色橡膠手套做出這些劍齒虎的服裝，然後把牙籤放在旁邊，而我會打扮成金鋼狼(Wolverine)。”

德賴佛補充說，他10歲的兒子之前對觀看他的電影幾乎沒有興趣，但現在終於期待看到其中一部。“我兒子其實對《X戰警》感到興奮。此外，到了這個時候，他年紀漸長，還沒有看過我參與的任何作品，但他去過片場。他想看到我在某部電影裡，”德賴佛表示。

漫威影業(Marvel Studios)的負責人凱文·費吉(Kevin Feige)承認，他在很長一段時間內一直在追求德賴佛，直到他最終答應參演《X戰警》，儘管這位演員通常會在與漫威討論後禮貌地拒絕。“我們想和亞當合作並不秘密，”費吉在《快樂、悲傷、困惑》(Happy Sad Confused)播客中表示。“但與他進行Zoom會議後，他會拒絕。這是一個長久以來的傳統。他非常有禮貌，通常會坦率表達他的感受。”

施瑞爾即將上映的《X戰警》重啟版將看到德賴佛與薇薇安·辛克(Sadie Sink)飾演的琴·葛蕾(Jean Grey)、印德·納瓦雷特(Inde Navarrette)飾演的羅格(Rogue)、基特·康納(Kit Connor)飾演的獨眼龍(Cyclops)、瑪雅·博伊德(Maya Boyd)飾演的風暴(Storm)、阿薩·格曼(Asa Germann)飾演的天使(Angel)以及克里斯托弗·阿博特(Christopher Abbott)飾演的查爾斯·薇克斯(Charles Xavier)/X教授(Professor X)對峙。該片將於2028年5月5日上映。
